messages:
irene: opened a focused PR to add a small 'compatibility checklist' for model-card -> catalog migrations and a few compact SDK snippets (Go + Ruby) + embedding-shard example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/624
phil: thanks! can we explicitly call out alias vs version vs variant semantics? customers keep assuming model_alias pins output.
irene: added a one-paragraph decision box: alias = soft pointer, model_version = immutable pin, model_variant = runtime option (quant/adapter). added inline example showing model_version usage.
aman: please include a one-line caution about embedding dim changes after quantization and a tiny reindex checklist. we had one customer break NN thresholds after a rollout.
irene: added checklist: verify embedding dims -> re-run similarity baselines -> re-index if dims changed. also example pseudo-code for client-side shard stitching (3 shards) and a warning: "do not change shard_count mid-ingest".
phil: can we add a minimal Go snippet for quant fallback and a Ruby example for long-context? infra teams asked for both.
irene: added Go snippet showing ModelVariant param and a Ruby curl variant for long context. Go snippet:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
res, _ := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateParams{Model: "stratus6b", ModelVariant: "q4_0", Input: "hello"})
fmt.Println(res.Text)
```
Ruby curl example:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"stratus6b","input":"<long transcript>","max_tokens":256}'
```
ux: small UX note: callers copy our snippets verbatim. prefer using "context_window" naming in examples to match SDKs rather than internal "sequence_length" param.
irene: updated examples to prefer context_window and added a short sentence about truncation fallback behavior.
aman: add a batching callout: For >8k contexts, small batch_window_ms increases p95 because larger sequence processing blocks worker slots. suggest sample: batch_window_ms=25 for mixed workloads.
irene: added batching guidance + sample config and a brief tradeoff diagram (one-line).
ci-bot: Link check: /docs/catalog#supported-models -> 404, probable new anchor /docs/catalog#available-models.
irene: thanks CI, fixed cross-links and searched for runtime#fallback references -> replaced with runtime#fallback-policies. pushed commit.
phil: can we include a tiny bench datapoint for stratus6b on A100 vs T4 so teams have expectations? infra gave quick numbers: p50 A100=20 tok/s, p95 T4=6 tok/s. added as indicative figure.
irene: included bench footnote and a cost/throughput callout reminding readers that Dedicated autoscale is not free and spin-up can take ~20-40s for heavy variants (pre-warm recommended).
aman: LGTM. i'll do wording nits in the PR.
phil: approving after a tiny edit on the decision box language.
ci-bot: Preview build OK: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/624 (build 8091) :white_check_mark:
irene: thanks! plan to merge after CI green and one final copyedit. ping me if you want the snippets converted to other languages or a separate short-runner for embedding reindex steps. :rocket:
